name: Amendments by the committee responsible – separate vote
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council decision amending Decision (EU) 2021/1764 on the Association of the Overseas Countries and Territories with the European Union including relations between the European Union on the one hand, and Greenland and the Kingdom of Denmark on the other
part_text: (7a) It should be stressed that many OCTs possess significant reserves of critical raw materials and renewable energy resources that are essential to the Union's strategic autonomy and green transition. Those resources are the sovereign patrimony of the peoples of the OCTs, who hold the primary right to determine the conditions of their exploration and exploitation. The pursuit of the Union's strategic objectives should never compromise the sovereignty, prosperity or environmental integrity of OCT communities.
